description: Source file for LocalizationService class managing localization, language files, validation, and translation handling in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LocalizationService
classes.description: Provides localization functionalities including language management, translation validation, import/export of language files, and error handling within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getLocalizationDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LocalizationDao instance used for database interactions related to localization.

methods.name: getI18NService
methods.description: Retrieves the I18NService instance from the service container.

methods.name: getLocalizationDateFormats
methods.description: Returns available localization date formats with example dates.

methods.name: getSupportedDateFormats
methods.description: Provides a list of supported date format patterns.

methods.name: getCurrentDateFormat
methods.description: Returns the currently configured default date format.

methods.name: getSupportedLanguages
methods.description: Fetches a list of supported languages based on system configuration.

methods.name: searchLanguages
methods.description: Searches languages based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getLanguagesArray
methods.description: Normalizes and returns an array of language models from search results.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateTranslatedStringsFromRows
methods.description: Saves or updates translations for a given language from provided rows.

methods.name: saveImportErrorLangStringsFromRows
methods.description: Saves import error language strings associated with a language and employee.

methods.name: createTranslatedItemsFromRows
methods.description: Creates translation entities from raw row data for a specific language.

methods.name: createImportErrorItemsFromRows
methods.description: Creates import error entities from row data for a language and employee.

methods.name: generateLangStringLanguageKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key combining language and string IDs.

methods.name: exportLanguagePackage
methods.description: Exports a language's translations into an XLIFF package as an XML string.

methods.name: getXliffXmlSources
methods.description: Builds an XML document representing translations grouped by language groups, suitable for file export.

methods.name: getTargetLanguageFromFile
methods.description: Extracts the target language code from an XLIFF DOMDocument.

methods.name: validateTargetString
methods.description: Validates target translation strings against source patterns and syntax rules.

methods.name: getI18NErrorByName
methods.description: Retrieves a predefined I18NError object corresponding to an error name.

methods.name: processXliffFile
methods.description: Validates and processes an uploaded XLIFF file, returning validation results.

methods.name: validateXliffFile
methods.description: Checks the integrity, schema, version, and target language of an XLIFF file.

methods.name: validateLangStrings
methods.description: Validates individual language strings within an XLIFF file for correctness.

methods.name: languageHasImportErrors
methods.description: Checks if a language has associated import errors for a specific employee.

methods.name: clearImportErrorsForLangStrings
methods.description: Removes import error records for a list of language string IDs.
